measurement.frameLatency: DOM correctness at a subsequent RAF opportunity; not native compositor or photon latency.
measurement.clock: Constant offset aligns market candle boundaries; real timers, performance.now and native OS counters are not slowed or accelerated.

energy.reason: Total app/device energy and GPU energy cannot be attributed. Privileged powermetrics is unavailable; per-task CPU energy is measured separately with the supported kernel nanojoule counter.

interpretation.scope: Synthetic native intake and a controlled active page; external market network, physical presentation, and total device/GPU energy are not measured.
interpretation.resources: CPU% is percent of one core over complete sampled intervals. CPU seconds and CPU-only joules require every interval; W is CPU joules divided by covered elapsed seconds. Footprint mean/peak use complete snapshots; peak is sampled. Coverage cannot detect every short-lived process or all WebKit work.
interpretation.trialCounts: This compact evidence retains counts and trial summary statistics. Exact recorded search terms/expected result counts and delivery targets are retained in the hashed raw report and the complete attribution-analysis output, not repeated here. The runner persists the full correctness oracle separately as oracle.json with oracleSHA256; indicators are checked by the browser, not independently recomputed by this summary.
interpretation.latency: Per-trial p50/p95 use the helper nearest-rank definition. Grouped latency distributions are medians/min/max of trial percentiles, never pooled observations. Source-to-RAF includes clock calibration uncertainty; RAF is a DOM opportunity, not physical presentation.
interpretation.liveAcknowledged: A unique delivery is acknowledged when its unique matching live record is committed, caught up and has a valid receive-to-RAF latency; delivery status counts are reported separately.
interpretation.raf: RAF opportunities per second are the count divided by the recorded phase duration, which includes phase settling.
interpretation.transport: Counters are the server phase snapshot for RPC routes and outbound event channels; bytes count serialized payloads, excluding framing. Events include controller commands as well as notifications. Missing keys remain null, and counts do not include every OS transport operation.
interpretation.contrasts: Baseline eligibility checks the overall workload; each contrast separately checks paired targets and per-metric coverage. Within-round absolute change = candidate − baseline; relative percent = (candidate − baseline) / baseline × 100 only for a positive baseline. CPU% absolute changes are percentage points of one core. Aggregate median/min/max require all three pairs and complete coverage for that metric.
interpretation.interaction: (native/off − native/full) − (http/off − http/full), separately by runtime and resource group. Positive means the signed effect of telemetry removal is greater with native transport. This is a difference of absolute effects, not a relative percentage.
interpretation.limits: Three pairs describe observed variation, not statistical significance. Diagnostic, profiling, smoke, failed, incomplete or unequal workloads never enter baseline causal estimates.

profiling.limitation: Separate instrumented run. V8 weighted observations and exclusive timeline wall time are not measured per-function CPU or energy. Native counts include waits, heuristic operation context, and unresolved JIT; no CPU category percentages.

trace.limitation: Innermost recognized complete events on the renderer main thread, unioned to avoid nested double counting. Instrumented wall time is not OS CPU or GPU time. Paint includes SVG and non-SVG; it is not an SVG-only measurement.
